turnAssumption.note: One authoritative simulation turn is one in-game calendar day. Production, transport ETAs and construction progress are driven by the central simulation clock.

HYDRAULIC_BRINE.name: Brine pumping / evaporation or direct extraction

HARD_ROCK_CRUSH_FLOTATION.name: Hard-rock drill, blast, crush and flotation

factoryCatalogPolicy.observedDataPolicy: Unknown real-world values remain NOT_RECORDED; factory profile values below are explicitly simulation-only.
factoryCatalogPolicy.quantityPolicy: All recipe coefficients are deterministic simulation ratios on the declared SIMULATION_TONNE_EQUIVALENT basis; no implicit unit conversion is allowed.
factoryCatalogPolicy.missingInputPolicy: A production cycle requires every declared recipe input. Missing or untracked required inputs block the cycle.
factoryCatalogPolicy.outputPolicy: Output batches are created once per committed transaction, retain source-batch lineage and are added to the processed warehouse exactly once.
factoryCatalogPolicy.capacityPolicy: Factory profile capacity is a maximum processed production-unit quantity per simulation day; resource availability and all recipe coefficients further constrain output.
